column1: # tests/spec_history/cite_floors.tsv -- the least number of citations of a
# numbered spec doc the citation check must find in the tree (K35: a scan that
# reads nothing passes everything). One row per doc that carries the
# `<!-- spec-toc:begin -->` block; a doc with no row FAILS. Columns: doc stem,
# floor. Set at about half the count measured when the doc adopted numbering
# (match_api: 1,009 on 2026-10-09; registry: 89, table_contract: 29 at their adoption; facts_listing 8, ir_listing 7 and findings 107 at theirs; rxt_format 69 at its; tuning 1,105 at its).
